items.class_root: This is a class, not a one-off: any renderer module that imports ProseMirror through a `@tiptap/pm/*` sub-path (or any prosemirror-* package) that is NOT in the same Vite pre-bundle set as `@tiptap/starter-kit` will resolve to a second instance in dev, and ProseMirror's identity-sensitive machinery (DecorationSet/Node/Mark/Selection `instanceof` and `.eq`) breaks silently across instances. The failure only surfaces at runtime when a real EditorView merges decorations from both instances, so unit tests (which never build an EditorView or merge multiple decoration sources) cannot see it, and production (single prosemirror-vendor chunk) is immune — which is exactly why it slipped past 21 PRs of CI. The remedy is to force ALL of the editor's ProseMirror entry paths through one shared pre-bundle graph so esbuild dedupes prosemirror-* to a single instance, and to add a dev-mode journey that actually opens the Creation editor so any future re-split is caught.

Each vendor-config field decided its own at-rest representation, so apiKey/customConfig became encrypted while proxyUrl/extraHeaders stayed plaintext. Without one boundary that answers "is this field a credential payload, and if so it must ride the encrypted store", any current or future credential-bearing field can silently land as plaintext.

items.class_root: Connected/usable state for a vendor must be derived from a single source of truth, not from two flags (vendor.enabled and credential.enabled) that separate call sites are trusted to keep in sync. A renderer credential edit is always disabled-pending-certification and always invalidates any prior certification, so it must de-publish the vendor in the SAME operation at the one shared boundary every renderer credential save funnels through — rather than each UI caller remembering the paired upsertVendor({enabled:false}). Enforcing it per-card invites each new save path to skip the pairing and re-introduce the desync.

items.class_root: External-source ingestion is a class, not a one-off: any connector that turns a user/agent-supplied reference into fetched bytes has the same four obligations (sender-bound IPC, encrypted-only credential write, hardenedFetch+origin allowlist for every outbound call, and AssetSourceEvidence with rightsStatus:'unknown' for every landed media). The failure mode of doing it per-connector is that one connector forgets one obligation and reintroduces a plaintext key, an SSRF hole, or unattributed media. The remedy is to make each obligation a single shared boundary that every ingestion path is forced through, and to prove the new connector routes through them.

items.class_root: Asserting a connection/capability as ready without a real check against the dependency is a recurring class across BYO-key connectors: the safe design is that persisting the credential and reporting 'connected' must be strictly downstream of a successful authenticated probe, and that probe must hit an endpoint that actually requires the credential (never a free/unauthenticated liveness endpoint). Doing it per-card invites each new card to skip the check and re-introduce a fake success. The remedy routes the credential write through a single service choke point (saveTikhubApiKey) that verifies first, and reuses the existing outbound boundary so the check inherits the SSRF/allowlist/failover protections rather than opening a parallel path.

items.class_root: 『off-canvas 安静渲染』这个 advisory + U4 阳性对照指标的可信度，取决于探针能否只在『某目标组件本次 commit 真的重跑了自己的函数体』时计一次。它是 DevTools 全局钩子在浏览器 realm 里跨 commit 遍历 committed fiber 树，唯一能拿到的稳定信号是每个 fiber 的 (memoizedProps, memoizedState) 身份。任何『单 commit 内』的判据（actualDuration>0、self-time>0、fiber 与其 alternate 同 commit 比对）都会被 committed 树上驻留/冻结的脏值骗过——因为探针每 commit 重走 root.current，而 bailout 的子树 fiber 及其 alternate 关系跨多个 commit 原样驻留。修在最早共享边界（探针计数规则本身）：把规则收敛成跨 commit 差分——记住每个目标实例上次的 (memoizedProps, memoizedState)，仅当这对在两次 commit 间变化才计一次真渲染，bailout 冻结不计；抽成单一导出纯函数 createOffCanvasRenderTracker（既被单测钉死、又以 .toString() 原样注入浏览器 init script，单一真相源）。修好后 dev 腿 off-canvas 从假的 584/192 变成真实 ~10/4，恢复其作为可信 advisory + 阳性对照的资格。这不是修某个组件的渲染，而是修量具『怎么判定一次真渲染』。

items.class_root: 缺的不变量是「仓库里的源文件必须始终是**纯文本**，即不含裸 NUL」。这条此前完全没人守：裸 NUL 在编辑器里不可见、粘贴/生成代码时极易带入、运行期又毫无差别，所以它既不会被作者发现，也不会被任何测试、类型检查或 lint 发现——唯一的症状是**别的工具从此少看见一个文件**，而那是个否定式的、没有报错的症状。同一份代码里已经存在正确写法（src/ui/onboarding/modelSettingsCatalogProjection.ts:43 用的是 `\0` 转义），说明这不是「不知道该怎么写」，而是「写错了也没有任何东西会告诉你」。因此正确形状是加一道扫全仓字节的硬零门岗，让「文件不再是纯文本」这件事在 CI 当场可见，而不是靠人记得用转义。

items.class_root: 门岗断言持有真相源的派生值副本（数量、名单、聚合数），而守它的 job 与该真相源不在同一个触发面上。两个条件缺一不可：只要断言是 derive 的，真相源一变它就跟着变；只要门岗与真相源同触发面，落后当场就会被发现。两者同时不满足时，落后可以潜伏任意久，并在一个无关改动上以「别人的锅」的形态爆出来。本仓的风险分层验证（R22「改哪面验哪面」）是正确设计，但它的结构性代价正是：当 B 面的断言依赖 A 面的真相源时，改 A 不会执行 B 面的断言。同一份 19 工具名单在 tests/ux/mcp-l1-handshake.e2e.mjs 里也是硬编码的，却被 #359 正确更新了——差别只在于它所在的 lane 会被 MCP 改动触发。同样的硬编码，一个跟上一个落后，证明决定性变量是触发面而非作者是否细心。

items.class_root: Vocabulary lists that exist in two forms (type union + runtime Set) invite member drift when the type is updated but the Set is not, or vice versa. The correct shape is: one authoritative type union, one derived Set exported from the same file, and one vocabularies-baseline entry pointing at the type (not the Set). Any module needing a runtime whitelist imports the derived Set; no module maintains its own copy.

items.class_root: A callback whose identity is per-call was passed through a vendor boundary whose caching key cannot represent callback identity. The missing invariant is: any object handed to a memoized vendor API must be stable across calls, and per-call variation must be carried in mutable state that the stable object reads at call time, not in a fresh closure per call. Without it the failure is silent by construction - no error, no type violation, correct output blob - and it only manifests on the second and later calls, which is exactly the path least likely to be exercised in a first-run smoke test.

items.class_root: Startup library work is sized by the whole library instead of by the items that actually need work, and the same full-library pass is performed more than once per launch. Two concrete forms were found and fixed under this one class. Form 1 (discovery): discovery/migration is a one-time reconciliation against projects the registry does not yet know about, but it was implemented as 'every launch, re-read every project on disk and re-register every one of them'; the missing invariant is that discovery may only touch project directories absent from the registry, and may only read them through the lock-free snapshot reader. Form 2 (startup GC): gcEmptyDraftWorkspaceProjects called listWorkspaceProjects itself, so the full 372-manifest enumeration ran twice per cold launch - once inside the GC whose result was discarded, once again in listProjects twenty lines later; the missing invariant is that one listProjects call performs at most one full-library enumeration, and any startup pass that needs the library must consume the caller's already-computed snapshot rather than recomputing it. Both forms make startup cost proportional to library size rather than to the work actually required, so every user's launch degrades as the library grows.

items.class_root: Approval-bearing mutations become non-reconcilable when planning, execution, and durable evidence are owned by different process boundaries. A document write must prepare a receipt with the frozen approval/action hash, execute only after the real confirmation, commit the same receipt after an applied result, and transition it to undone or unresolved on failure using revision CAS. All transport adapters must resolve the same main-process writer rather than inventing or injecting a final receipt.

items.class_root: 同一个校验函数同时承担两件性质不同的工作：判断一条记录的**形状**是否合法，和判断它的**跨实体引用**在某个状态里是否解析得到。前者对历史和现状同样成立，后者只对「产生这条 patch 的那个状态」成立。把两者绑死之后，调用方无法表达「我在校验历史，请只验形状」，于是历史被迫满足一个只有现状能满足的不变量。这一族的共同特征是**故障发生在写入之后很久、在另一个进程生命周期里**——写入走快路径不重扫历史，所以开发机上永远看不到，要重启才现形。UI 那一半是同族的另一种表达：一个操作在界面上被提供、在边界上被拒绝，而拒绝没有任何人接住。

items.class_root: The logger decided the meaning of stderr for the whole main process — a developer's terminal, therefore dev-only. But one process mode has a different meaning: launched with NOMI_MCP_STDIO=1, stdout is handed entirely to JSON-RPC and stderr is the host protocol surface, the only channel through which a host can see any diagnostic at all. Nothing in the logger let a process declare that, so every call site migrated into the logger silently lost its host-facing half. (2) the dispatch document has no slot for the search, so each executor sees only its own slice and nobody holds the question. (3) a discipline that lives only in prose is invisible under load - the same mechanism as 2026-09-07's framework-boundary contract, one layer upstream: that one covered 'a capability the framework already provides', this one covers the decision to write anything at all. the identical shape produced the hooks failure in this contract's scope: a guard that only exists after `pnpm install` is a guard by luck, and a docs-only session that skips install has none of it, silently.

items.class_root: The project-save boundary lacked an asynchronous, ordered receipt that retained staged validation and awaited real disk commit across every caller. Asynchronous acquisition exposed both main-process waiter overtaking and renderer lifetime gaps: cleanup sampled a runtime already owned by another project, explicit saves bypassed pending automatic writes, and clearing the active UI target erased access to unfinished write receipts.

items.class_root: A checklist can only detect items on the checklist. Any review whose input is a list we authored inherits our blind spots exactly, so it finds duplication of known capabilities and never finds absence of unknown ones. Catching the second class requires an input we did not author - the framework's own complete, working implementation - taken apart along its own seams rather than sampled against our seams. This is the same shape as R30's lesson from the same week (design-lab baselines certify appearance, not behaviour, because the baseline is generated from the thing being judged) and as R14.1's dual-path check: an artefact derived from the subject cannot be evidence about the subject.

items.class_root: Two compounding gaps, both about what counts as evidence. First, the seeded catalog had no automated comparison against the provider's live model list for the text/LLM lane, so a curated entry could only be corrected by a human noticing. Second -- and this is what made the reported case invisible even to a listing check -- presence in GET /v1/models is not evidence of liveness: deepseek-v3.2-think is still enumerated by the relay today and only a real call reveals it is dead. Any check that treats the provider's own listing as the truth will keep shipping models that cannot be called.

items.class_root: The class is 'one semantic fact, two file-level owners, resolved by precedence rather than by structure'. Precedence hides drift instead of preventing it: whichever source loses is free to say something else, and nobody finds out until a third party reads the losing one. Two structural amplifiers were present here. (1) Our reader was more lenient than the ecosystem's, so the strict side's failures were invisible to us — leniency asymmetry always makes the lenient side blind, never safe. (2) The second owner had no schema discipline of its own: skills/workbench-storyboard-planner/skill.json declared a `storyboardProfile` block that is not in the zod schema, so parseSkillManifest silently stripped it, and it had already drifted from the renderer's hand-maintained copy in src/workbench/generationCanvas/agent/storyboardProfiles.ts (literal Chinese labels there, i18n keys here) while that file's comment claimed the value came from skill.json.

items.class_root: Nothing in the repository asked the question 'does a standard for this already exist' before a shape that outsiders also read or write was designed. R5 requires reading official docs when touching a third-party library, but a file format we author does not present itself as a third-party library -- it looks like our own internal structure, which is the self-justification this class always uses. The judgement that actually matters is different and machine-checkable: besides our own code, is there a second program, or a human hand-writing the file, that reads or writes this thing. Two further mechanisms kept it alive after it was noticed. First, the delivery scoring function rewards producing an artifact and does not penalise skipping the search: inventing skill.json is visible output, whereas finding that the shape was already fixed and therefore writing nothing looks like an empty round -- the same mechanism R29 and check:prior-art were built for. Second, the 2026-08-27 fix addressed the half the user could see (imports now succeed) and thereby removed the only signal pointing at the parallel file, so the export side and the copy went on producing it for another eleven days.

items.class_root: The embedding mechanism and the confining policy are one decision, and they were being made in two places that never met: an iframe attribute in a React component, and a global response header in the main process. Nobody owned the pair, so the pair was incoherent -- a mechanism that needs a response-header policy, in a host where that mechanism cannot load at all. The invariant that was missing: whoever chooses how untrusted content is embedded must also ship the policy that governs it, through the same channel that mechanism actually uses. A src-navigated document is governed by response headers; an inherited-context document (srcdoc/blob/data) is governed by its own inline meta plus the host's policy, and no response header will ever reach it.

items.class_root: **一个「等人决定」的状态，被允许由时间而不是人推进。** 三处的形状是同一个：判据里混进了「已经等了多久」这个量，而这个量与「用户想不想花这笔钱」毫无关系；一旦混进去，无人看管就等于默认答案（付费卡答「不」、检查点答「批」——方向相反，同样不是用户的意思）。与它同构的第三个变体是「宿主已经答了，但答案没有出口」：`act` 把失败吞掉，用户那头看到的同样是「时间过去了，什么都没发生」。所以修法不是调时长、不是加一个开关，而是**把时间从审批判据里彻底拿掉，并保证宿主的每个回答都有一个用户看得见的出口**。第四处更进一步说明这个形状为什么反复长出来：写「不能死等」的人是对的——一个请求确实不能永远挂着——但**活性的判据被错选成了「等了多久」，而正确的判据是「那个要按按钮的界面还在不在」**。换成后者，活性一分不少（窗口关了、渲染进程没了、主窗口被换掉都立刻 fail-closed），而时间彻底退出审批。

items.class_root: 一个必需依赖被写成 optional，缺席时不是在**构造期**失败，而是把「残废实例」交出去，让失败推迟到调用期再发生——于是所有基于「这个能力存在吗」的判断都得到肯定答案，而真实答案是否定的。这一族的三个标志同时出现在本例：① 工厂/注册处能以零参构造；② 依赖缺席时能力仍被无条件挂上（`certifyComfy` 照挂）；③ 用它的闭包在第一行重新判一次 undefined 并抛一个 `*_unavailable`。第③点看着像防御，实际是把「构造期就该炸」的错误挪到了最难诊断的地方，再被上游的统一 catch 洗成一个中性状态码。这正是 R28 点名的那一族（安全/关键依赖不许「optional + 欠账登记」），与 #722「付费门缺人证时放行」同源：都是**一个必需前提被表达成可选**，只是一个 fail-open、一个 fail-silent。修法必须是把前提搬回构造期让编译器拦，而不是在闭包里把错误信息写得更漂亮。 第二跳属于同族的另一种表达：**同一个事实（上游到底给没给任务编号）在同一个函数里被算了两遍、两份答案可以不一致**，而下游的闸只问其中一份。处置方向同样是「让它只有一个答案」——在算出来的那一处就把来自上游的编号回填进 providerMeta，本地兜底编号刻意不回填（那道闸要拦的正是「拿伪造编号去轮询」）。

items.class_root: The parser encoded a single assumed wire shape for a value that a live, still-evolving upstream service serializes in more than one way depending on which node-authoring API produced the node, and had no fallback branch for the shape it did not anticipate. The missing invariant: a local index of an external service's capability description must recognize every shape that service's own current source code can legitimately emit, not just the shape observed in one historical sample. The same class already bit this codebase once before (electron/catalog/comfyuiWorkflowImport.ts's MEDIA_INPUT_KEYS / electron/catalog/comfyuiLocal.ts's STANDARD_MEDIA_LOADER_INPUTS: LoadVideo's real input key is 'file', not the assumed 'image', discovered against 259 real corpus workflows) and was independently rediscovered by an unrelated local-first AI creation tool (Velorn, PR #107, 'Fix dynamic ComfyUI combo choice parsing') hitting the identical ['COMBO', {options}] shape gap.

items.class_root: Nomi published a machine contract without keeping it honest about itself. Each of the six surfaces answers a question the caller must answer to take the next step - what is required, what went wrong, whose turn it is, which handle to send, which session am I in - and in each case the published answer was either absent, ambiguous, or contradicted by the implementation. The missing invariant is: every fact a caller needs to take the next step must be published in the contract the caller can read, and must be the same fact the implementation enforces.

items.class_root: The gate outlived the spend it authorized. On 2026-09-11 the paid real-generation step was deleted from onboarding (certification became a free self-check), but the three-stage human-approval gate that existed solely to authorize that payment was left standing. The missing invariant: an onboarding stage must be leavable by whoever owns the session — no stage may require an actor that the session's owner cannot be — and no approval gate may survive the deletion of the thing it approved.

items.class_root: 外壳级容器关系（哪一块占哪一行哪一列、谁被谁顶上去、有没有空格子）是**不变量**，但它的唯一实现是一串 Tailwind 类名：类名改错既不影响编译、也不影响任何既有测试。缺这条不变量的拥有层时，任何一次「顺手调一下布局」都能把整个面切成两半，而且能漂很多天——d2bb622c1 当晚落地的走查注释至今还写着「生成画布的时间轴是 col-span-full，宽度不随助手面板变」，代码和它自己的走查注释当场对不上，5 天里没有一道闸红过。同族的第二条：面板级动作（收起整块）被放进了内容级的滚动容器，容器一窄它就不可达。 第二轮验证了同一条类根因的另一面：**底部这一排东西属于外壳，画布只是其中一块**；把「谁在下沿」的名单范围钉在画布上，等于让外壳层的障碍对避让算法隐身。两份实现同时钉错同一个范围，也说明缺的是 owner 而不是某一处的手误。

items.class_root: A verb's schema says what the model may send; a capability contract's inputSchema says what the host accepts; between them sits hand-written translation (verbToTransportCall, VerbDeclaration.semanticInputOf). Nothing in the repository ever evaluated that composition, so every drift between the two ends stayed invisible until a paid run hit it. The external MCP face already had the sibling gate (check-mcp-operation-constructible: every advertised operation must be constructible); the internal verb face had none, which is exactly why these defects clustered there. The same invariant has a second half that the schema composition cannot see: after the host accepts an input, the value still has to survive every downstream projection, and each hand-written field list is a silent drop point — that is how the shot title died five times in one chain on the same day.

items.class_root: A capability was restated four times — verb declaration, translation, contract schema, handler and its downstream projections. Two of those restatements have to exist: the model needs names that suit it (modelKey, durationSec) and the host needs its internal names behind a cross-process, spend-gated admission check. The third carries nothing but the correspondence between the first two, yet it was code, so the correspondence had no machine-checkable form: neither completeness (every verb field has a destination) nor validity (every destination exists on the host) could be stated, let alone enforced. The first half of the invariant (what the host requires, the verb must have told the model) does not imply the second: adding contentHash to the verb declaration would satisfy it while leaving the tool just as unusable, because no read verb returns contentHash. A correspondence that states only the destination cannot express that, so the table carries a provenance for every field as well.

Usable-stage geometry must account for intersecting fixed workspace chrome through its existing owner. Framework input exclusion must follow each actual DOM interaction surface, including portals, rather than only the React component ancestor.
